_fieldShape.adaptation: css-only = class substitution may work; structural = markup reorganization needed; framework = component-library adoption, not class translation
_fieldShape.classMap: source class → target class; null = drop the class (no equivalent)
_fieldShape.notes: context an agent must state in its output

_scope: Family-level compatibility hints (one entry per component family). The MCP translate_component tool prefers tile classMapping, then adapter registry entries (material/bootstrap), then these maps. Advisory entries (framework/structural) are returned as guidance only — the tool does not fabricate translations.

mismatches: GOV.UK has no secondary/outline button variants — use govuk-button--secondary for what USWDS calls 'base'
Disabled is disabled='disabled' in both; GOV.UK discourages disabled buttons entirely
GOV.UK buttons start with 'Start' styling for first CTA of a service
GOV.UK requires govuk-label + govuk-hint structure; USWDS label/hint pairing differs
Error messaging uses govuk-error-message linked via aria-describedby (same pattern, different component)
GOV.UK select styling is minimal; no arrow customization API
GOV.UK checkboxes render the whole control via a wrapper div pattern; DOM structure differs more than class names suggest
checkbox.notes: Verify rendered structure after class swap

mismatches: Same wrapper-pattern caveat as checkboxes
GOV.UK notification banner is page-level with heading + html content; USWDS alert is more granular (slim, no-icon variants have no GOV.UK equivalent)
role/aria conventions differ: govuk-notification-banner manages role='region' + tabindex
GOV.UK accordion sections are h2-wrapped buttons; USWDS uses h3/h4-size headings — adjust heading level
GOV.UK accordion has no multiselectable toggle; behavior is always multi-open
accordion.notes: JS behavior differs — use GOV.UK JS

mismatches: GOV.UK header is product-name + service-name oriented; USWDS extended/megamenu variants have no GOV.UK equivalent
Navigation markup completely different (govuk-service-navigation)
header.notes: Rebuild nav internals; keep landmark roles

mismatches: GOV.UK footer has fixed sections (meta, navigation, licence, OGL); USWDS big/collapsible footers have no equivalent
footer.notes: Adapt content into GOV.UK footer sections

mismatches: GOV.UK table has no striped variant; caption is required in both
GOV.UK deliberately has NO calendar component — it uses three separate day/month/year inputs
This is a UX-philosophy difference, not a styling one; do not port the USWDS calendar
date-picker.notes: Rebuild as govuk-date-input with three fields

uswds-to-carbon._scope: Carbon is a React/Vue/Web-Components component library, not a CSS class system. All mappings below are advisory: adopt the target component, carry over portableInvariants, do not attempt class substitution.

mismatches: Prop-based variants (kind='primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'|'ghost'|'danger') replace modifier classes
Carbon buttons are React components; event handling moves to props
button.notes: Carry over: semantic <button>, type attribute, accessible name

mismatches: Label + helper + error are props/subcomponents, not sibling elements
text-input.notes: Carry over: id/for pairing becomes controlId; aria-invalid via invalid prop

mismatches: Options are <SelectItem> children; placeholder handling differs
Grouping via <CheckboxGroup legendText>; fieldset/legend generated for you
RadioButtonGroup replaces manual fieldset+legend
USWDS alert kinds map: error→critical, warning→warning, success→success, info→info
Persistent vs auto-dismiss semantics differ (lowContrast, timeout props)
alert.notes: Choose InlineNotification for in-form, Toast for transient

mismatches: AccordionItem children replace button+region pairing
Managed via state + modal-launcher conventions; focus trap is built in
modal.notes: Carry over: aria-modal, labelledby semantics via props

mismatches: DataTable is a suite (TableContainer/Table/Toolbar) with sorting/selection props replacing USWDS JS
Flatpickr-based; single/range variants; no day/month/year-only mode without configuration
Carbon tags are filterable/dismissible via props; USWDS tags are static
Definition vs icon tooltips are separate components (Tooltip / Toggletip)
tooltip.notes: Never put critical info solely in a tooltip — same rule both systems
